newsitem.title: CANADA: WCE canola ends up on crushers, funds, exporters.
newsitem.headline: WCE canola ends up on crushers, funds, exporters.

text.p: WCE canola ended up on crusher, fund and exporter demand, traders said.

"Crushers bought 1,000 to 1,500 March, July and November, funds bought 1,000 March. There were 500 market on open hedges in March and 300 in May with Cargill buying both contracts, UGG buying May," a trader said. March canola futures crush margin fell to -21.78 Friday from -18.19 Thursday. March-May spread at $0.50, May-Nov $41, Mar-Nov $41.50.
Japan bought 1,000-2,000 tonnes overnight, sources said.
March canola rose $2 to $414.50, May up $2 to $414.10. March flax rose $3 to $353.50 on UGG buying.

March western barley rose $0.80 to close at $138.30 on commercial and commission buying spurred by late gains in CBOT corn. May rose $0.30 to $138. Twenty-five Mar-May spread at even money. Volume 1,200.
March feed wheat rose $2.10 to $168.70 on UGG demand, May rose $2.20 to $165.80 on commercial and commission demand.
Oats and feed peas did not trade.
(Values in Canadian dollars/tonne except oats and peas.)
